format: owner-authored preregistration version of contracts/s2-006-thresholds.json (fixture package; synthetic numerics proving the validated input path only)
rule: Fixture package: the numerics are synthetic and the method-owner principal is synthetic. They prove that a resolved threshold HumanDecision flows into the lexicographic decision rule; they never authorize any real calibration claim.

non_inferiority_margin.direction: lower bound of the paired confidence interval above -delta

sample_size_rationale.text: Fixture: 6 synthetic locked_test cases prove path conductivity only; the structural spec minimum for a real external corpus is not claimed here.

steps: Step two: quality and coverage jointly pass and the lower bound of the paired confidence interval is above -delta.
Step three: among eligible non-inferior candidates only, compare total cost.
Step four: compare latency under the frozen tie rule.
Step five: inconclusive outcomes resolve to HUMAN_REVIEW with no winner.
decision_rule.note: Step order is fixed by spec section 8.

notes: Abstain-all cannot win: precision without coverage is insufficient.
